=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~16834 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The filter `startswith("review / codex-agent")` is applied unconditionally to all completed check-runs when deciding whether Gate D blocks force-merge.
  WHY: A legitimately required `review / codex-agent` job that is cancelled would be ignored, letting the sweep force-merge a PR that branch protection would otherwise block.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~10550 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `jq -cn` expression only injects `sha: $hs` when `$hs != ""`, so a literal `"null"` can be treated as a valid SHA.
  WHY: Downstream blank-`head_branch` detection would see a non-empty `"null"` and bypass the in-flight-review guard, allowing a race with a queued `workflow_dispatch` review run.
